# graphiant_troubleshooting_site (Data Source)

A site status snapshot (troubleshooting domain), including per-edge device status.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_troubleshooting_site" "example" {
  site_id = graphiant_site.example.id
}

output "site_status" {
  value = data.graphiant_troubleshooting_site.example.site_status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `site_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `edge_statuses` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--edge_statuses))
- `site_name` (String)
- `site_status` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--edge_statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `edge_statuses`

Read-Only:

- `device_id` (Number)
- `device_name` (String)
- `device_status` (String)
